ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (Agreement") made as of THE PROTESTANT EPISCOPAL CHURCH IN THE UNITED STATES, a New York religious corporation, having an address at 175 Ninth Avenue, New York, New York 10011 ("Seminary-Lot 1 Owner"),THE GENERAL THEOLOGICAL SEMINARY OF THE corporation, having an address at 175 Ninth Avenue, New York, New York 10011 ("Seminary- Lot 101 Owner") and CHELSEA WEST 21st STREET, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at c/o The Brodsky Organization, LLC, 400 West 59th Street, New York,NewYork 10019("ChelseaWest"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Seminary-Lot 1 Owner was the owner in fee of an entire parcel of land, with buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York,originally known as Lot 1 in Block 718 on the Tax Map of the City of New York,andby the street address 175 Ninth Avenue,NewYork,New York,and more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof ("Original Tax Lot 1"); and WHEREAS, Seminary-Lot 1 Owner has severed a portion of Original Tax Lot 1 in order to form a new tax lot, which tax lot is known as Lot 101 in Block 718 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and is more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof ("Tax Lot 101"; the remaining portion of Original Tax Lot 1, less and except Tax Lox 101, is hereinafter referred to as “Tax Lot 1"); and WHEREAS, simultaneously herewith, Seminary-Lot 101 Owner is entering into a ground lease (hereinafter, the “Ground Lease") with Chelsea West with respect to Tax Lot 101 (said land being herein called the“Development Land", the buildings and improvements thereon, Agreement, being herein collectively called the “Development Building,”and the Development Land and the Development Building being herein collectively called the “Development Premises") (Tax Lot 1 being hereinafter referred to as the “Seminary Land,” the buildings and improvements thereon, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein collectively called the“Seminary Building,” and the Seminary Land and the Seminary Building being herein collectively called the “Seminary Premises"); and WHEREAS, Chelsea West and Seminary-Lot 101 Owner are hereinafter sometimes collectively called “Developer”,it being understood that, subject to Section 11.b. of this Agreement, the term“Developer”as used in this Agreement shall mean either/or Chelsea West, Seminary-Lot 101 Owner and their respective successors and/or assigns as tenants and/or owners from time to time of Tax Lot 101 and/or the “Condominium Units” (as such term is hereinafter defined);
